entries.OBJ_ACT1_FIND_LANTERN_OIL: Find whale oil to steady the lantern flame.
entries.OBJ_ACT1_THORNE_JOURNAL: Search the Captain's Cabin aboard the Merciful Requiem.
entries.OBJ_ACT1_FIVE_BELLS: Ring the five ship bells in the order written in Thorne's margin (La - Mi - Do - Mi - La).
entries.OBJ_ACT1_CARGO_ESCAPE: Use the surgeon's hook to unlatch the lower hatch and align two crates into the starboard rings.
entries.ECHO_LULLABY_LINE: Hush, little side, don't say a word...
entries.MIMIC_LULLABY_LINE: Hush, little child, don't say a word...
